title: Elmwood Signature Estate
description: A magnificent five-bedroom estate in the heart of Gulshan-2. Soaring double-height ceilings, chef's kitchen with island, wraparound terrace overlooking lush private garden, and a rooftop lounge. Finished with Italian marble, solid oak flooring, and brushed-brass fixtures throughout.

title: Sky Residences — Tower A
description: Sleek 3-bedroom apartment on the 18th floor with panoramic skyline views. Open-plan living with floor-to-ceiling glass, modular Poggenpohl kitchen, spa bathroom, and access to rooftop infinity pool and fully-equipped gym. 24-hour concierge.

title: The Garden Villa
description: An idyllic four-bedroom villa surrounded by manicured tropical gardens. Private pool, shaded outdoor dining pavilion, and sun terrace. Peaceful embassy-district location minutes from international schools and diplomatic missions.

title: The Copper Loft
description: Industrial-chic two-bedroom loft in a converted warehouse. Original exposed brick, polished concrete floors, factory windows flooding the space with light. Rooftop terrace access. Walking distance to lakeside restaurants, galleries, and cafes.

title: Riverside Penthouse
description: Full-floor penthouse with 270-degree river and city views. Private elevator, wine cellar, home cinema room, two private terraces, and a rooftop plunge pool. The pinnacle of luxury living in Dhaka — an unrivaled address.

title: Heritage Row House
description: A beautifully preserved heritage-style row house with original ornate molding and hardwood floors restored to perfection. Four bedrooms, a sunlit study, private courtyard garden, and a double-height reception room with original fireplace.

title: Studio at The Arc
description: Cleverly designed studio with integrated modular furniture, high ceilings, and large pivot windows. Building amenities include gym, co-working lounge, and ground-floor specialty café. Perfect for young professionals or couples.

title: Palm Court Villa
description: A grand six-bedroom villa set behind high security walls in Baridhara DOHS. Embassy-district address, mature tropical gardens, 50ft swimming pool, staff quarters, triple garage, and a separate guest house. Unmatched scale and privacy.
